orientation_note: Back view: the machine FRONT (platen/paper side) faces AWAY from the camera. Machine-left = image-left, machine-right = image-right (verified: the crank/chain drive, which sits on the machine's left, appears at image-left here). The near (camera-side) corners are therefore the BACK corners; the FRONT (platen-side) top-frame and base corners sit directly behind the near beam/slab and are occluded. Base/cone/cylinder/pinion sit in the base bay: cone gear end-on at image-left, cylinder gear drive-hub center, pinion (chain sprocket) hidden behind the rocker-arm fan. Rocker arms are viewed nearly EDGE-ON and heavily overlapped; the four corner dots are the frontmost/lowest arm, whose long edges appear as the arm's top/bottom (I mapped 'left' = lower long-edge corner, 'right' = upper long-edge corner). Arm width tapers ~51px (butt) to ~34px (tip), confirming butt=left/wide, tip=right/narrow. Rocker corners are low-confidence due to the edge-on stacking.
